# Public test fixtures

`deflate-encrypted.zip` and `v4-encrypted.rar` are unchanged public examples from
https://github.com/ofk/libarchive-wasm/tree/main/archives (MIT; license copied at
../../vendor/libarchive/LICENSE). They are used only to test rejection of
password-protected archives. They contain no patient examinations.

DICOM and unencrypted ZIP/RAR fixtures are generated in tests; no clinical
patient data is committed.
